result.decision_rationale:
The Windows build and all 120 controller checks passed. Two gaps still affect frozen-candidate qualification. A clean receipt can include artwork absent from its recorded commit, and an installer can admit a build-owned ZIP before its receipt is visible. Publication, report writing, and reinstall recovery also have open failure paths.

## Continuation for Claude

Bind authored compiler inputs to the producing Git tree. Coordinate publication and installer reads so they observe one ZIP and receipt, and repeat the current-input check after acquiring the publish lock. Capture validation input identities through the handles used to read their bytes. Recover the recon setting from existing journals. Extend the temporary fixtures to exercise these cases, two distinguishable overlapping builds, and redirected test output with a stale runner. Preserve the supported external-package and diagnostic modes. Keep this work within Waking Rune’s configured controller gates and budget. The native rows remain NOT RUN under the existing runtime authorization.

executed_verification: The controller receipt binds the baseline gate to 5432227c865a2a95296b6de00671a01b6a24c8ac. It records exit 0, 476.6 seconds, 120/120 checks and an unchanged worktree. I verified the supplied gate log’s SHA-256.

The gate built shipping version 0.12.3 from an empty cache at H and validated its receipt. The ZIP SHA-256 was c10018413ab4a2d6646d9ff01cd049f71a277938ea72da26938f8df3746ef1a3. The product DLL SHA-256 was 7cd3cb09f12f75a7247c1b401673528a0773a139e59dc3a940da860c28f24904. The log also records 290 passing focused tests, direct MSBuild’s three pinned inputs, and rejection of the genuine 0.33.2-compiled release DLL with a lowered manifest.

The retained 3779b0e build receipt and package report agree on ZIP b7a824f226aa16304ae89bde52a87c3b3f52f52d58c2d9c501c6bd7af799e0ee, the same DLL digest, and MVID ccc59117-f992-44ce-9355-540d35f181f0. The static audit records 14 type references and 39 member references resolved on all four profiles. Changes from 3779b0e to H are documentation and evidence only.

I matched the supplied 10,554-line feature diff to Git, verified all 22 indexed evidence-blob hashes, and checked that each retained boundary-suite report contains 120 distinct passing cases. A read-only git check-ignore confirmed the ignored portrait path in R1-F1.

The full feature diff and the round-5 corrections, including the production and test projects, reference targets and pins, build inventory, package publisher, validator, file-identity helper, install helper, journal recovery and regression fixtures.

limitations: The reviewer used the read-only snapshot. The controller withheld the mixed foreground transcript. The candidate-bound gate log and the separately dated repository exports establish different runs.

Native behavior is NOT RUN on UMM 0.31.1, 0.32.4, owner-installed 0.33.0 and 0.33.4. The repository has no approved disposable game copy. The journal fixture stops before Steam, and no combined-stack run is recorded.

OWNER AMENDMENT 1 accepts the historical absence of contemporaneous pre-enrollment check-project evidence. The retained current check-project, preflight and profile comparison document the effective configuration. The historical gap stays recorded.
The supplied draft-PR description readback predates round 5 and records the earlier 108-check run. The live PR body was outside this offline review.
required_gaps: Demonstrate correct frozen qualification for ignored authored inputs, and preserve qualification across changes to files the project does not embed.
Exercise two distinguishable publishers, a material input change while publication waits, and installer admission during ZIP/receipt placement or rollback.
Exercise redirected test output with tests enabled, protection of the actual file read during a concurrent rename, and recovery from the previous recon journal format.
source_inspection_only: The ignored-art clean-receipt result, the installer’s receiptless publication window, and the stale publication after a lock wait follow from the source. The controller gate did not execute those interleavings.
The snapshot identity gap and recovery of a pre-round-5 interrupted journal were assessed from the read and recovery paths. The gate exercised related cases with different timing or journal contents.

findings.actual: The project embeds assets/portraits/*/*.png. Git ignores assets/portraits/obj/LocalOnly.png under the existing obj/ rule. Both git status and the new ls-files --others --exclude-standard check omit it. Its bytes appear in the build and current compiler inventories alike, so the validator can return verified-current for a commit that lacks the embedded image. Conversely, comparing all of assets rejects a documentation-only change such as assets/README.md.
findings.blocking_rationale: A fresh checkout of the recorded clean commit can produce a different DLL from the one qualified by the receipt.
findings.expected: Frozen qualification binds the membership and content of authored source and embedded resources to the recorded commit.
findings.requested_correction: Compare the project’s authored inputs with the recorded Git tree independently of ignore rules. Use the actual embedded-resource patterns for artwork, and retain the existing treatment of generated files, pinned caches and external references.
findings.requested_evidence: In a temporary checkout, put a valid PNG at the ignored portrait path and show that the build cannot qualify it as a clean frozen candidate. Retain the added-committed-icon and restored-build controls, and show that an artwork-directory documentation change preserves qualification.
findings.title: Ignored artwork can enter a clean frozen candidate
findings.trigger: Build with an ignored local PNG that matches the production EmbeddedResource pattern.

findings.actual: Build.ps1 moves the ZIP into place at line 176 and the receipt at line 177. New-KwrValidatedPackageCopy copies the visible ZIP and tests independently for its sidecar. During that interval it takes the external-content-inspected path. A dirty build can therefore be admitted without -Diagnostic, even if receipt placement subsequently fails and the publisher rolls back.
findings.blocking_rationale: Concurrent publication can silently drop the provenance check required for a build-owned package at the installation boundary.
findings.expected: An installer reading a build-owned destination sees a complete published pair, waits, or declines the read.
findings.requested_correction: Coordinate the installer’s ZIP and sidecar snapshot with publication for build-owned destinations. Preserve content-only inspection for genuinely external receiptless ZIPs.
findings.requested_evidence: Pause a temporary publication between the two placements and call the real copy helper. Show that a dirty pair cannot enter default mode during the pause, and that rollback exposes only the restored pair. Retain the genuine external-ZIP control.
findings.title: An installer can read a ZIP before its receipt is published
findings.trigger: Begin or Reinstall snapshots a package while Build.ps1 is placing or replacing its ZIP and receipt.

findings.actual: The HEAD and fingerprint check runs at line 73. Standalone validation finishes before the publisher starts waiting for the lock, which can take up to five minutes. Once the lock opens, the build places the earlier pair without checking its inputs again. It can return success and occupy the immutable version filename with a pair that immediately fails current validation.
findings.blocking_rationale: A queued build can publish an obsolete candidate and prevent an ordinary clean retry for that version.
findings.expected: The build checks that its source and material inputs are still current when it obtains permission to place the pair.
findings.requested_correction: Perform the final source and material-input check under the acquired publish lock, before moving either previous file.
findings.requested_evidence: Use the existing lock-holder fixture. Change a material input after private validation and before releasing the lock. The waiting build should decline placement and preserve the previous pair’s hashes.
findings.title: A waiting publisher can place a candidate that has gone stale
findings.trigger: HEAD or a material compiler setting changes while a validated build waits for the destination lock.

findings.actual: The gate runs one Build.ps1 process against a lock held by the test. It establishes waiting and subsequent placement. The sidecar-conflict case runs separately. Neither run has two producers with distinguishable DLLs. Per-process MSBuild settings can produce distinct DLLs in the same checkout while HEAD and the tracked files remain stable.
findings.blocking_rationale: The requested observation that a competing publisher’s failure preserves the winning compile and its receipt is still missing.
findings.expected: The concurrency regression identifies which of two overlapping production invocations owns the surviving ZIP and receipt.
findings.requested_correction: Exercise both real publishers against the same temporary destination. Use process-local compiler settings to distinguish their outputs and synchronize the placement conflict.
findings.requested_evidence: Record both compiler-output digests, each publisher’s result, the surviving ZIP and receipt hashes, and standalone validation of the winner under its recorded settings.
findings.title: The concurrency test exercises one publisher
findings.trigger: Assess the round-5 evidence for overlapping builds and rollback.

findings.actual: The output-redirection case at line 667 still passes -SkipTests and restores the original properties at line 673. The test-enabled stale-runner case at line 796 uses those restored properties. Its 290-pass result establishes execution with ordinary settings.
findings.blocking_rationale: The gate still lacks the test-enabled run for the configuration that originally selected the wrong executable.
findings.expected: The newly built runner controls packaging with OutputPath redirected and a distinguishable passing executable present at bin/Tests.
findings.requested_correction: Combine the existing redirection and stale-runner fixtures in one test-enabled Build.ps1 invocation.
findings.requested_evidence: Show the active redirection, the stale executable’s unchanged digest, and a distinguishable result from the invocation-owned runner that controls the package outcome.
findings.title: The stale-runner regression omits output redirection
findings.trigger: Review the gate result offered for the redirected test-output fix.

findings.actual: The validator opens the input paths to sample IDs, closes them, then reopens the paths for Copy and ReadAllBytes. A replacement can supply the bytes actually read between the samples. If that file moves to the report destination before the second sample, its ID is absent from the protected set and WriteChecked can truncate it. The gate moves the input after both samples.
findings.blocking_rationale: Writing a validation report can still destroy the ZIP or receipt whose bytes were inspected.
findings.expected: The protected identities include the exact files read into the validation snapshot.
findings.requested_correction: Read each supplied input’s identity and bytes through the same open handle. Retain those identities through the existing checked-handle report write and preserve protection of the conventional adjacent receipt.
findings.requested_evidence: Use a temporary replacement that becomes the snapshot source between the current samples and then moves to the report destination. Report publication must refuse and preserve the bytes actually read.
findings.title: Snapshot identity and snapshot bytes come from separate opens
findings.trigger: The package or receipt is replaced during snapshot acquisition and the file actually read moves to the report path.

findings.actual: The previous script wrote recon=true and could persist phase=reinstalling after removing the mod directory. Such a journal has no reconEnabled field. The new fallback tests the missing recon.flag, writes reconEnabled=false, and completes recovery with diagnostics disabled. The gate starts the interruption using the new writer.
findings.blocking_rationale: Recovery can admit a launch with different diagnostic behavior from the existing transaction record.
findings.expected: Recovery preserves the recorded recon setting for both current and existing interrupted journals.
findings.requested_correction: When resuming an existing interrupted journal, recover its recorded recon value if reconEnabled is absent and the previous installation is gone.
findings.requested_evidence: Start the temporary recovery fixture with the previous journal format, recon=true, phase=reinstalling, and no installed folder. Verify recon.flag and the journal before launch admission. Include the corresponding false control.
findings.title: Recovery loses recon mode for existing interrupted journals
findings.trigger: Resume a transaction interrupted by the previous script version before its replacement mod directory was placed.

findings.actual: PowerShell unwraps a one-element ArchiveEntry array returned by Get-PinArchiveEntry. The conditional assignment of ArchiveSha256 does the same. The subsequent string checks accept both values. A read-only PowerShell value check confirmed the coercion.
findings.blocking_rationale: The checked-in definitions have the intended types, and the archive and DLL byte checks still apply.
findings.expected: The pin reader distinguishes a JSON string from an array containing one string.
findings.requested_correction: Check the underlying property values’ types before PowerShell enumerates them.
findings.requested_evidence: An offline definition check distinguishes singleton arrays from the equivalent scalar strings.
findings.title: Archive-field validation loses the original JSON type
findings.trigger: Supply a one-element JSON array for an archive entry or archive digest.

prior_finding_assessments.rationale: The gate rejects the extra committed icon and the /recurse response file. Ignored local resources still escape the Git membership check and can receive clean provenance.

The candidate gate rejected the UMM NuGet definition with both archive fields cleared. It accepted the raw Harmony12 definition with omitted keys and acquired the expected aa1cd483… DLL from an empty cache.

Section 16 uses a separate checkout. The retained full run starting at 0.12.99 passed 120/120 and preserved the shipping ZIP and receipt hashes across the 0.12.100 build. The gate at H also exercised the isolated pair.

The source now stages privately, records the captured compile digest, and locks placement and rollback. The recorded test used one publisher and a lock holder. Verification of the requested two-producer conflict remains open.
Build.ps1 now builds and launches the tests from its private folder. The two gate cases separate redirection from test execution, leaving the requested combined regression unverified.
The gate preserved an input moved after both identity samples. The implementation still samples pathnames separately from the handles that supply the snapshot bytes.

The current-format journal recovered recon=true in the gate. The immediately preceding journal format already records recon, and the new fallback loses that value when the installed directory is absent.
The suite and both retained exports identify the stored receipt as the rebuild after restoring the section-11 compiler settings.
The suite reads Win32_LogicalDisk.VolumeSerialNumber through CIM. The candidate gate shows the independently read serial and file index matching the validator’s ID.

summary.delivered_behavior: Waking Rune declares UMM 0.31.1 and its built DLL references UnityModManager 0.31.1.0, Harmony12 1.2.0.1 and Harmony2 2.3.1.1. The wrapper builds in private output folders, and the standalone validator inspects the packaged DLL. Static API checks resolved on all four loader profiles.
